**ABSOLUTELY READ-ONLY.** Do NOT edit, stage, commit, stash, checkout, or modify anything. Two other agent sessions are writing to this working tree. Use ONLY: `git show`, `git diff`, `git log`, `grep`, `cat`/`sed -n`. Because the working tree is being mutated by others, verify file CONTENT via `git show HEAD:<path>` NOT by reading the working tree. Compute line numbers via `git show HEAD:<path> | cat -n | sed -n 'Np'`.

Verify these claims EXACTLY. For each report CORRECT / WRONG (state what's actually true) / STALE (right substance, wrong line/count) / OVERSTATED / UNVERIFIABLE.

## §2 Contentful data flow claims

1. "The content model — five types, all reference-linked. All live in `scripts/contentful/content-types/`, one file per type." — list actual files there at HEAD. Is it exactly five types? Are they all `.js`? Nothing nested/embedded, every relationship a reference array — verify.
2. **`region`** type: "`siteId` (required, unique), a human `label`, and a `locale` field that is explicitly informational only. Its comment states the contract: `siteId` matches an SFCC site ID from `contentfulMapping.generated.ts`'s `SITE_LOCALES` keys." — verify each field and the comment. Does `contentfulMapping.generated.ts` exist and export `SITE_LOCALES`?
3. "**nothing else in the model carries a hardcoded site list.**" — verify by grepping the content-types dir for site IDs like `Zimmermann`.
4. **`link`**: "`label` (localised) + `href` (not localised) + optional `regions`. its description says it's designed to be referenced from header nav and mega-menu later without change." — verify.
5. **`footerNavGroup`**: "one column: `heading` (localised), a required `links` array, and a `showContactChannels` boolean." Quote claim: `footerNavGroup.js:9-10` says *"A flag, not a heading match — heading is localised, so matching its text breaks per storefront."* — verify byte-for-byte and the line numbers.
6. **`footerConfig`**: "`internalTitle` (the `displayField`), `subscribeHeading`/`subscribeBody`, required `navGroups`, optional `legalLinks`, `copyrightOwner`, the three contact channels, and its own optional `regions`." — verify every one of these fields exists, that `displayField` is `internalTitle`, and that navGroups is required and legalLinks optional.
7. **`uiCopy`** content type: "Four fields: `title` (required, non-localised, and the `displayField`), `key` (required, unique, non-localised — *"Must be identical across locales to work as a map key"*), `value` (required, **localised**), `description` (optional, translator context)." Also: "`value` is a **`Symbol`, not `Text`**, so Contentful caps it at 256 characters". Also "The `uiCopy` content type's own description claims entries are fetched *"one CDA call per locale"*". Verify all of this byte-for-byte.
8. `overrides/app/utils/resolveByRegion.ts`: verify it exists and:
   - "it accepts anything shaped `{fields: {regions?: [{fields: {siteId}}]}}`"
   - "Eligibility (`:22-26`) — an entry with omitted or empty `regions` matches every site."
   - "Specificity (`:29-30`) — `regions.length` where non-empty, else `Infinity`."
   - "`pickMostSpecificByRegion` (`:52`) — single winner"
   - "`filterByRegion` (`:37`) — inclusive"
   - "Ties between two equally-scoped non-global entries resolve by most-recently-updated with a `console.warn` (`:71-79`)."
   Verify every line number and the described behaviour.
9. "`scopeToRegion` (`footer/index.tsx:132-144`) is the second stage — it maps over `navGroups` running `filterByRegion` on each group's `links`, and over `legalLinks`." — verify line range and behaviour.
10. Flow diagram citations — verify EACH file:line:
   - `overrides/app/hooks/useContentfulClient.ts:44` = `createClient({space, environment, accessToken, host})`
   - `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:183` = `useEffect → getEntries({content_type:'footerConfig', include:3})` (is include really 3? is line 183 right?)
   - `overrides/app/utils/resolveByRegion.ts:52` = pickMostSpecificByRegion
   - `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:132` = scopeToRegion
   - `footer/index.tsx:204` = `<Footer data={footerData}>`
   - `footerNavColumn/index.tsx:57` = `links.map → ZimmNavItem`
   - `footerNavColumn/index.tsx:89` = `showContactChannels && <ZimmContactIconRow>`
11. "**`site.id` comes from `useMultiSite()`** (`footer/index.tsx:170-173`)." — verify.
12. "`FooterContainer` (`:160-205`) is the default export and does the fetching. The presentational `Footer` (`:56`) is a named export taking `data` as a required prop" — verify line ranges and that `data` is REQUIRED on Footer.
13. "the code flags this itself at `:156-158`:" quote: *"Note this puts a fetch inside `components/`, which components.md reserves for containers; if that matters, this should move into an `_app` override instead (Tier 2 shared shell — coordinate first)."* — verify byte-for-byte + line range.
14. "base `_app/index.jsx` renders `<Footer />` with no props" — verify the actual filename/extension in node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app (is it .jsx?) and that it passes no props.
15. "**Was:** the footer rendered from a static fixture, so it was present in the server-rendered HTML." — verify against `git show ec9d161:overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx`. Did it render from a static fixture at ec9d161?
16. "`footer/index.tsx:202` is `if (!footerData) return null;`" — verify exact line and text.
17. "That single `return null` covers four states ... and all four are tested (`footer/index.test.tsx:145-220`)." — verify the test file exists at that path (note: .test.tsx), and that lines 145-220 test four states: fetch pending, fetch rejected, no matching entry, no Contentful client configured. Verify all four are ACTUALLY tested.
18. "The rationale at `:154-156`: *"no fallback to placeholder content once wired to live data, so a Contentful outage doesn't silently ship stale placeholder copy to real shoppers."*" — verify quote and lines. NOTE: the doc also cites `:156-158` for a different quote in claim 13 — check for overlap/contradiction.
19. "`uiCopyProvider/index.tsx:29-32` states the contrast: *"losing a button label or a status message to a Contentful outage should never blank a control."*" — verify path (is it `overrides/app/components/uiCopyProvider/index.tsx`?), lines, and quote.
20. "`contentfulFixture.ts` was **renamed**, not deleted: it's now `footer/index.stories.content.ts`, and `FOOTER_FIXTURE` is imported by exactly one file — `footer/index.stories.tsx`. Not by `footer/index.tsx`, and not by `footer/index.test.tsx`." — verify with `git diff -M --name-status` and grep for FOOTER_FIXTURE across the repo at HEAD.
21. "the `tel:+61280808080` and `wa.me` values still exist in the repo" — verify exact strings.
22. "each passes through `isSafeHref` before reaching an anchor (`zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:62`), with an inert labelled fallback when rejected" — verify line and behaviour.
23. "`LOCALE_LABEL_PLACEHOLDER = 'Australia (AUD) / ENG'` hardcoded at `bottomBar/index.tsx:15`, rendered as a non-interactive `div`" — verify exact string, line, and that it renders as a div.
24. "The old pipeline — `sync.js`, `runMigrations.mjs`, `detectDrift.mjs`, `001-initial-content-types.mjs` — was deleted." — verify each was deleted in this range. Did `runMigrations.mjs` and `detectDrift.mjs` and `001-initial-content-types.mjs` actually exist at ec9d161?
25. Commands table: `npm run sync:contentful`, `npm run install:contentful -- --target dev`, `npm run seed:contentful-regions -- --target dev` — verify these scripts exist in package.json at HEAD with those exact names.
26. "`migrate:contentful` and `detect:drift` are gone" — verify they existed at ec9d161 and are gone at HEAD.
27. "**One new env var:** `CONTENTFUL_ORGANIZATION_ID`, tagged `# scope:shared` / `# mrt:false` in `.env.sample` and pre-populated" — verify it's in .env.sample at HEAD with those exact tags and a pre-populated value. Is it really the ONLY new env var in this range? Diff .env.sample ec9d161..HEAD.
28. "the install call defaults `deleteDeletedFields` to `false` ... the new pipeline has one reachable via `--delete-deleted-fields`. `protectedFiles.md` was updated to describe this accurately." — verify.
29. "`sync.js` had *no delete path in the code at all*" — verify against `git show ec9d161:scripts/contentful/sync.js`.
30. `ad6...`/`ad4fbc6` Experience Builder fix: "fixed two independent bugs ... a 404 guard that always matched in canvas mode (because `useFetchBySlug` returns no experience there) and a hydration mismatch from `typeof window !== 'undefined'` initialisation. Both fixes sit behind guards a real shopper cannot satisfy — `params.has('expEditorMode')` and an SDK `mode` value only set via Studio `postMessage`." — verify with `git show ad4fbc6`. Which file? Is `params.has('expEditorMode')` the literal code?

Report terse findings organised as WRONG / STALE / OVERSTATED / UNVERIFIABLE / CORRECT, with exact real line numbers where the doc's are wrong.

    31	 * Derived from the scheme rather than keyed to a channel name: tel: and mailto: hand off to the
    32	 * OS dialer or mail client and never navigate, so a target on them does nothing. An http(s)
    33	 * channel — WhatsApp today — is a real cross-origin navigation and opens in a new tab so a
    34	 * shopper mid-browse does not lose the site. Any future http(s) channel inherits this without
    35	 * another edit here.
    36	 */
    37	const leavesTheSite = (href: string | undefined): boolean => /^https?:/i.test(href ?? '');
    38	
    39	/** WCAG 3.2.5 — a link that opens a new tab has to say so in its accessible name. */
    40	const NEW_TAB_SUFFIX = ' — opens in a new tab';
    41

    43	 * Contact channel icon row (phone / WhatsApp / email). Extracted from the footer so it can be
    44	 * reused anywhere a storefront needs the same channels — nothing here is footer-specific.
    45	 *
    46	 * @param props see ZimmContactIconRowProps
    47	 */
    48	export const ZimmContactIconRow = ({ phoneHref, whatsAppHref, emailHref }: ZimmContactIconRowProps) => {
    49	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_CONTACT_ICON_ROW_RECIPE, {});
    50	  const links: ContactLink[] = [
    51	    { href: phoneHref, label: 'Call us', icon: 'phone' },
    52	    { href: whatsAppHref, label: 'WhatsApp', icon: 'whatsapp' },
    53	    { href: emailHref, label: 'Email us', icon: 'email' },
    54	  ];
    55	  return (
    56	    <chakra.div __css={styles.row}>
    57	      {links.map(({ href, label, icon }) =>
    58	        // isSafeHref, not a truthiness check: these typically arrive from Contentful, so a
    59	        // javascript:/data:/protocol-relative value would otherwise be rendered straight onto
    60	        // an anchor. Rejected values fall through to the span below, which is already the
    61	        // correct treatment for "no usable destination".
    62	        isSafeHref(href) ? (
    63	          <chakra.a
    64	            key={icon}
    65	            href={href}
    66	            // rel is explicit rather than relying on target="_blank" implying noopener: that is
    67	            // browser default behaviour, not a guarantee, and noreferrer also stops the
    68	            // storefront URL leaking to the third party.
    69	            {...(leavesTheSite(href) ? { target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener noreferrer' } : {})}

    71	            __css={styles.iconLink}
    72	          >
    73	            <ZimmIcon type={icon} size="md" aria-hidden={true} />
    74	          </chakra.a>
    75	        ) : (
    76	          // Fallback for a channel with no usable destination — either the field is absent, or
    77	          // isSafeHref rejected the value. Both reach here, and both want the same treatment.

    81	          //   - labelled, not aria-hidden: ZimmIcon emits role="img" + aria-label, so screen
    82	          //     reader users learn the channel exists instead of getting silence (avoids the
    83	          //     1.1.1 information loss the previous aria-hidden caused).
    84	          // Not dead code: contact channels are optional per storefront, so a locale that
    85	          // supplies only e.g. email still renders the other two icons this way.
    86	          <chakra.span key={icon} __css={styles.iconLink}>
    87	            <ZimmIcon type={icon} size="md" aria-label={label} />
    88	          </chakra.span>
    89	        ),
    90	      )}
    91	    </chakra.div>
    92	  );
    93	};

Author: TimLavelle <tim+1@lavelle.bio>

    fix(contentful): render Experience Builder canvas correctly in Contentful Studio
    
    Two independent bugs prevented the /:slug Experience page from ever rendering
    inside Contentful Studio's Experience Builder canvas iframe (blank canvas,
    empty component picker), despite working fine on the live site:
    
    - useFetchBySlug's canvas-mode detection branches on `typeof window !==
      'undefined'`, which differs between the SSR pass and the client's first
      hydration pass inside an iframe, causing React hydration errors #418/#423
      that discarded the whole render. Defer ExperienceFetch's mount until after
      hydration, scoped only to Contentful's canvas requests (detected via the
      `expEditorMode` query param, visible server-side) so normal storefront SSR
      is unaffected.
    - In editor/canvas mode, useFetchBySlug always returns `experience: undefined`
      by SDK design — the real data arrives via postMessage instead. Our own
      `!experience` check was treating that as "page not found" and never letting
      ExperienceRoot mount at all. Now only applies that check outside
      supervised/editor mode.
